verdict.rationale: Airwallex's first-party docs describe a broad public API surface that a user or agent can call directly. It covers the Card Expenses API, Bills API, transfers and FX, with scoped API keys, OAuth partner connections, typed server-side SDKs and a separate sandbox for testing. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use (all evidence is vendor documentation).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Card Expenses API lets you retrieve approved card expenses from Airwallex and mark them as synced after ingesting them into your ERP or accounting system.
The Bills API lets you create and manage invoices received from vendors for goods or services.
A scoped API key grants only the resource permissions you assign (Read or Write on specific APIs), instead of full account access.
Partner Connections use OAuth 2.0 to securely authorize access, allowing you to call Airwallex APIs on behalf of connected accounts.
`@airwallex/node-sdk` is a TypeScript-first SDK designed for integrating with the Airwallex platform APIs using Node.js.
